data: Is the red line in the bottom middle plot consistently higher than the blue line?

The red line represents the 2L GRU model, and the blue line represents the GRU model. In the bottom middle plot, the red line is consistently higher than the blue line across the entire range of the x-axis. This indicates that the 2L GRU model has a better goodness-of-fit score compared to the GRU model for all values of the average log probability.
